answer: First the registry seeds a new identity into a grove of peers who issue micro-benchmarks: five short inference jobs, each stamped with a 90-second wall-clock deadline and a nonce, so a clone farm cannot serialize the same GPU across fake keys without missing deadlines. The verifier then samples one benchmark at its peak, the identity's zenith of claimed throughput, and requires live re-execution within 40 seconds; a cedars-rooted reputation anchor records pass or fail.
